options.content: UFM port census, active alarms, fabric-health score and IB switch scrape outcome. The ufm, ufm-telemetry and ib-* collectors are stopped; every panel is preserved unchanged and repopulates on restart. IREN_MKZ schedules with Slurm — there is no Run:ai and no Kubernetes on this stack.
